=== anonymous forward-auth from nginx

> X-Forwarded-Proto: https
> X-Forwarded-Uri: /private?x=1

< Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-EfDB+E4ozGZyNnGeFWw8YAFIRzU40oZ2Hx4vap8d8mI='; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'

< Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
< Www-Authenticate: Cookie realm="wicket"
< X-Auth-Redirect: {{public}}/login?app=whoami&rd={{public}}%2Fprivate%3Fx%3D1

< X-Frame-Options: DENY
< X-Request-Id: golden-1

=== OpenID Connect login and callback
> GET {{public}}/login?app=whoami&provider=corp&rd={{public}}%2Fprivate%3Fx%3D1
> Accept: text/html
< HTTP/1.1 302 Found
< Cache-Control: no-store
< Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-EfDB+E4ozGZyNnGeFWw8YAFIRzU40oZ2Hx4vap8d8mI='; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
< Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
< Location: {{idp}}/authorize?client_id=wicket&code_challenge=<pkce#1>&code_challenge_method=S256&nonce=<nonce#1>&redirect_uri={{public}}%2Fcallback%2Fcorp&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&state=<state#1>
< Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
< Set-Cookie: __Host-wicket-login-<login#1>=<cookie#1>; Path=/; Max-Age=600; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax
< Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
< X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
< X-Frame-Options: DENY
< X-Request-Id: golden-3
<
<a href="{{idp}}/authorize?client_id=wicket&amp;code_challenge=<pkce#1>&amp;code_challenge_method=S256&amp;nonce=<nonce#1>&amp;redirect_uri={{public}}%2Fcallback%2Fcorp&amp;response_type=code&amp;scope=openid+email+profile&amp;state=<state#1>">Found</a>.

> Accept: text/html
> Cookie: __Host-wicket-login-<login#1>=<cookie#1>

=== signed-in forward-auth with identity headers and upstream token
> GET {{public}}/auth
> X-Forwarded-Host: {{host}}
> X-Forwarded-Proto: https
> X-Forwarded-Uri: /private
> Cookie: __Host-wicket=<cookie#2>
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Cache-Control: no-store
< Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-EfDB+E4ozGZyNnGeFWw8YAFIRzU40oZ2Hx4vap8d8mI='; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
< Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
< Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
< X-Auth-Email: alice@example.org
< X-Auth-Groups: eng,admins
< X-Auth-Provider: corp
< X-Auth-Token: jwt{{"alg":"ES256","kid":"<key#1>","typ":"JWT"}.{"iss":"{{public}}","aud":"whoami","sub":"alice","email":"alice@example.org","name":"Alice","groups":["eng","admins"],"idp":"corp","sid":"<session#1>","iat":"<T+0s>","nbf":"<T+0s>","exp":"<T+2m0s>"}}
< X-Auth-User: alice
< X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
< X-Frame-Options: DENY
< X-Request-Id: golden-5

=== logout
> POST {{public}}/logout
> Accept: text/html
> Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
> Cookie: __Host-wicket=<cookie#2>
> 
> csrf=<csrf#1>&rd=
< HTTP/1.1 303 See Other
< Cache-Control: no-store
< Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-EfDB+E4ozGZyNnGeFWw8YAFIRzU40oZ2Hx4vap8d8mI='; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
< Location: {{idp}}/logout?client_id=wicket&post_logout_redirect_uri={{public}}%2Flogged-out
< Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
